This is a **comparison of object–relational database management systems** (ORDBMSs). Each system has at least some features of an [object–relational database](/wiki/Object%E2%80%93relational_database "Object–relational database"); they vary widely in their completeness and the approaches taken.

This is a **comparison of object–relational database management systems** (ORDBMSs). Each system has at least some features of an [object–relational database](/wiki/Object%E2%80%93relational_database "Object–relational database"); they vary widely in their completeness and the approaches taken.

The following tables compare general and technical information; please see the individual products' articles for further information. Unless otherwise specified in footnotes, comparisons are based on the stable versions without any add-ons, extensions or external programs.
